descriptors.definition: Double taxation occurs when the same income is taxed in both the residence country and the source country under their respective tax laws. Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements establish allocation rules to prevent this simultaneous taxation and mitigate prohibitive international operating costs.
inclusion: application of source and residence rules
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes between taxation based on origin versus taxation based on taxpayer domicile

descriptors.definition: Relief from double taxation is provided through bilateral agreements between governments or unilaterally by a resident country for foreign taxes paid. Bilateral relief typically utilizes exemption or tax credit methods, whereas unilateral relief is applied under domestic law provisions.
inclusion: unilateral foreign tax credit under section 91
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes between relief negotiated mutually via treaty and relief granted independently by domestic statute

descriptors.concept_name: Double Taxation Relief Provisions Under The Income Tax Act, 1961
descriptors.definition: Sections 90, 90A, and 91 empower the Central Government to implement bilateral and unilateral agreements for granting tax relief, avoiding double taxation, exchanging information, and recovering taxes. Assessees can apply the provisions of the Act or the agreement, whichever is more beneficial.
inclusion: agreements with foreign countries or specified territories
exclusion: arrangements creating opportunities for non-taxation through tax evasion
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes between government-to-government agreements and association-level agreements under specific statutory parameters

descriptors.definition: A permanent establishment denotes a fixed place of business through which an enterprise's business is wholly or partly carried on. Under DTAAs, a non-resident's business income is generally not taxable in India unless such a permanent establishment exists.
inclusion: places of management, branches, offices, factories, and mines
fixed locations for carrying out enterprise operations
exclusion: preparatory or auxiliary activities such as certain liaison office functions
nearby_distinctions: contrasts the wider domestic scope of business connection with the narrower operational requirement of a permanent establishment

descriptors.concept_name: Taxation Of Business Process Outsourcing Units In India
descriptors.definition: Foreign entities outsourcing IT-enabled services to resident Indian entities are taxed in India only if the resident unit constitutes a permanent establishment. Profits attributable to such a permanent establishment are determined as if it were a distinct and separate independent enterprise.
inclusion: outsourced IT-enabled services creating a permanent establishment
profit attribution for separate enterprise operations
exclusion: independent resident service providers operating without business connections
nearby_distinctions: distinguishes between independent outsourcing contractors and dependent agents acting as permanent establishments
